sql:
SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12 AND a.date BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1993-12-31'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1
